discovery: Photonic crystals and the photonic band gap: controlling the emission and propagation of light in periodic dielectric media
subfield: Optics and photonics / wave physics in structured media
motivation: In 1987 Yablonovitch and John independently proposed that a periodic dielectric can possess a complete photonic band gap: Yablonovitch to inhibit spontaneous emission, John to create strong (Anderson) localization of light. Yablonovitch then fabricated the first three-dimensional photonic band-gap crystal ('Yablonovite', 1991). Their ideas turned light into a clean laboratory for the band theory of solids. They showed that the vacuum's electromagnetic density of states can be engineered, which changed quantum optics and cavity QED. They founded the field of photonic crystals, which led on to photonic-crystal fibres, high-Q nanocavities and low-threshold lasers, slow light, silicon photonics, topological photonics and the localization of light in disordered lattices. This is conceptual originality of the highest order. It created a new discipline with reach far beyond optics, into condensed matter, atomic physics and technology, and it has had real technological impact.
